limits: Counts overlap in scope; they are not a release completion percentage.
All-lock Python audit does not cover vendored libraries or operating-system packages.
Standalone Redis is qualified; Redis Cluster cross-slot operation and legacy physical orphan cleanup are not certified.
Full local working-tree tests, browser journeys and container builds concern separate private candidates and must not be attributed to this small publication cohort.
Broad hosted CI and production/provider/recovery/endurance gates remain required.

scope_notes: Prometheus local validation used the clean review source with the previously qualified API dependency image in an owned bridge network. Hosted Linux host-gateway wiring remains subject to its CI run.
The existing accumulated Ruff checkpoint remains a required gate; this change does not waive historical lint debt.
The owned HTTP latency test now accepts the owned backend URL and merchant credential; its numerical latency expectations are unchanged.
Cache-test formatting preserves AST semantics; email extraction moves the original implementation without changing its address grammar.
Hosted broad tests remain required; successful local targeted checks do not imply hosted or release green.
